title: Maggie and the Little Water Pump
moral: With patience and courage, problems can be solved.

scenes.summary: Maggie rides her horse Star and checks the ranch water pump.
scenes.text: Maggie rides at dawn with her horse Star and checks the water pump that the ranch needs.

scenes.summary: The water pump stops working and the ranch needs water.
scenes.text: The pump handle becomes stiff and water does not come out.

scenes.summary: Maggie carefully fixes the pump using tools.

scenes.summary: Water flows again after Maggie fixes the pump.

story: Maggie rides at dawn with her horse Star and checks the water pump that the ranch needs. The pump handle becomes stiff and water does not come out. Maggie uses a wrench and carefully removes a small pebble from the pump. After fixing the pebble the pump works and water splashes again. After the storm Maggie keeps everything safe and feels proud of her work.
